messages.content: I’ll lock in a DA arbitrage position: charge during the four cheapest hours and discharge during the four highest-priced hours. I’ll start with the same physical schedule, then reassess at each watch as RT prices and notices arrive.

The battery is fully charged at 40 MWh. RT prices have been weak, and the only ERCOT Watch was cancelled; there are no derates. With no reliable signal favoring a different discharge window, I’ll retain the 19:00–23:00 CPT schedule.
